'''Rhymer''' was a [[TIE pilot]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="CCG-Rhymer" /> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|11|END 7-10|The Battle of Endor}}</ref> he became a [[Major/Legends|major]], and was the lead [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for [[Scimitar Squadron (Imperial)/Legends|Scimitar Squadron]], an elite [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]]. Flying under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Scimitar 1/Legends|Scimitar 1]],<ref name="CCG-Rhymer" /> Rhymer flew a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/sa]] [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] equipped with an advanced [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting system]] to increase damage during [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]].<ref name="CCG-Scimitar1">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Scimitar 1}}</ref>

Prior to 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Rhymer and his [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] were stationed in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]], with the task of destroying any ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]] or equipment that might land on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]],<ref name="FF" /> which contained the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]] protecting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]]. During the battle, Rhymer and other TIE pilots were on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], and attempted to evacuate before the [[Space station/Legends|station's]] destruction.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Rhymer wore the standard TIE pilot [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]].<ref name="CCG-Rhymer" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rhymer first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="ROTJ" /> in a scene filmed between [[February 25]] and [[March 1]], [[1982]] at [[Elstree Studios]]'s stage 6.<ref name="making">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> He was named in [[2000]]'s ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="CCG-Rhymer" />
